steps.title: Configure Android Manifest permissions and service declarations
steps.description: Declare foreground service permissions, media playback service type, internet access, wake locks, and register BackgroundAudioService, MainActivity, and HistoryActivity.

steps.title: Set up application dependencies and Gradle configuration
steps.description: Define Java 8 source compatibility, compile and target SDK version 34, minimum SDK 21, and application packaging parameters.

steps.title: Create app metadata configuration
steps.description: Define application metadata including app_name, package_name, and app_id for runtime context initialization.

steps.title: Define UI color palette and theme resources
steps.description: Create dark theme color definitions including YouTube red accent, surface colors, text primary, and background styles.

steps.title: Create custom UI layout drawables and control icons
steps.description: Add custom vector drawables for navigation controls, play/pause state icons, refresh, history, and rounded button drawables.

steps.title: Design main activity layout with navigation toolbar and webview
steps.description: Construct responsive layout with header navigation bar, progress bar indicator, high-performance WebView frame, and error state view.

steps.title: Implement watch history SQLite database manager
steps.description: Build HistoryDbHelper to handle creation, insertion, retrieval, and deletion of user watch history records using native SQLite database.

steps.title: Design watch history screen layout and custom list adapter
steps.description: Create layout files for watch history view and list items with title, timestamp, URL display, and delete action handler.

steps.title: Implement watch history activity logic
steps.description: Create HistoryActivity to load past watch records, handle single item deletions, execute full history clearing with confirmation dialog, and handle item selection.

steps.title: Develop foreground media session service for background audio
steps.description: Implement BackgroundAudioService with MediaSession, AudioFocus handling, PowerManager WakeLock, foreground notification controls, and task removal lifecycle logic.

steps.title: Implement audio stop before next video playback
steps.description: Inject JavaScript event listeners for single-page navigation and video element replacement to pause and reset previous video audio state before starting next video.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Final build, verification, and APK assembly.
